title: Things – To-Do List App for Mac and iOS
description: Things is a premium, award-winning todo app page with a clean white Apple-inspired aesthetic. Uses refined typography with generous whitespace that creates an airy, premium feel. App screenshots are displayed in device frames showing real interface detail. Clean card-based feature sections with subtle shadows and rounded corners. The overall layout follows Apple's design conventions — centered hero with product shot, three feature columns below, and prominent App Store download buttons. No aggressive marketing — just clean product presentation.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for premium consumer apps and iOS products needing an Apple-style, trust-building product page.
style_vibe: Clean, premium Apple-style aesthetic with refined typography, device mockups, and generous whitespace.
